episodes.title: The Hawk
episodes.summary: After experiencing a tragedy on the course, past-his-prime golfer Lonnie Hawkins decides to make one last stand to achieve his career Grand Slam.

episodes.title: The Family That Plays Together
episodes.summary: As the golf world gathers for a tearful farewell, Lonnie infuriates Lance and Stacy by choosing the fairway over the funeral home.

episodes.title: Roses & Thorns
episodes.summary: When Lonnie's game begins to waver, Sam helps him reconnect with his roots. Natalie tries to overcome Stacy's smothering presence on the green.

episodes.title: Tears of a Hero
episodes.summary: Lonnie's triumphant return to the PGA Tour is dampened by a Danish rival. Lance and Natalie host an engagement party to remember.

episodes.title: The Prison Yard
episodes.summary: Lonnie lands a magazine cover that leaves his entire circle seething. Sam's past finally catches up with her.

episodes.title: The Genesis Invitational
episodes.summary: Lonnie, Lance and Golden sow chaos on the course when they're paired for a tournament round. An unwelcome discovery pushes Natalie to her limit.

episodes.title: Vegas
episodes.summary: With $3 million on the line, father and son go head-to-head in a simulation golf tournament in Vegas — and all bets are off.

episodes.title: The Code
episodes.summary: In the messy aftermath of the Vegas trip, Lonnie tries to win back Sam's trust, Stacy has complicated feelings and Lance hits rock bottom.

episodes.title: Pebble
episodes.summary: Lonnie revisits the scene of his worst defeat. Stacy and Golden get down to business. Lance gains an enhanced perspective on his daddy issues.

episodes.title: Pickle
episodes.summary: Lonnie, Lance and Golden compete for championship glory at the U.S. Open — where the trophy isn't the only thing being chased.
